tools.name: futility_register_run
tools.description: Register a run with its alternatives and operator-registered source identities (strings or {id, aliases}) before judging.

tools.name: futility_judge
tools.description: Record one usefulness judgment (useful / useless / partial) for a run/source/domain and return the binding verdict (CONTINUE / STOP-SOURCE / INTEGRATE-NOW / ABSTAIN). Billed as a verdict call: one-time trial, tier allowance, or x402 $0.002.

tools.name: futility_verdict
tools.description: Read the current verdict for a run/source/domain without recording a judgment.

tools.name: futility_waste_report
tools.description: Waste report for a run: tokens spent after the verdict point, per source and per domain aggregate.

tools.name: futility_receipt
tools.description: Mint the HMAC-signed abstention receipt when the run/source/domain verdict is ABSTAIN.

tools.name: futility_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt payload {receipt, signature}; total rejection with a reason on malformed/forged input.
